responsibility: Declares default-channel decimal whole-number I/O for LONGINT and LONGCARD values. It mirrors LongWholeIO’s explicit-channel API but binds reads and writes to the current standard input and output channels, giving ISO-style convenience procedures for long whole numbers without requiring callers to pass ChanId values.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the published interface for default-channel LONGINT/LONGCARD decimal I/O, listing the ReadInt/ReadCard and WriteInt/WriteCard procedures. It differs from SLongWholeIO.mod, which supplies the wrapper bodies that call LongWholeIO on the standard channels.
